name: 247ChatMate
author: 247chatmate

sections.description:
247ChatMate is an intent-first WhatsApp chat widget built to help website visitors start conversations faster and give businesses clearer, better-qualified enquiries.

Instead of relying on a basic chat button alone, 247ChatMate guides visitors through simple structured prompts, helps them choose what they need, and moves them smoothly into WhatsApp with more context already captured.

Built for real businesses that care about conversion quality, not just clicks.

Core capabilities include:

  • Guided intent selection
  • Structured pre-chat visitor journey
  • Optional notes for extra context
  • Smooth WhatsApp handoff experience
  • Fixed freemium chip set
  • Lightweight, performance-first architecture

247ChatMate is designed to make WhatsApp lead capture feel more intentional, more useful, and easier for both the visitor and the business.
